ShowAnytime: Show the flyout at any time
QuitHint: Stop MediaBack and restore standard Windows media keys
SolidDefault: An opaque background by default. Make the details your own.
ImageFormats: PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF, TIFF · up to 40 MB
OpacityHint: 100% means an opaque background. Text and buttons stay sharp.
CoordinateHint: Offsets from the selected corner. Custom coordinates start at the top left.
CoordinateError: Enter an offset from 0 to 20000. Use a dot for decimal values.
HoldHover: Keep visible while the pointer is over the flyout
MusicOnly: Select only music in automatic mode
PinHint: Pin a player so a game or video cannot take over. If the pinned player closes, MediaBack waits for it instead of switching to the game.
ShowWebsite: Show the website for browser sources
WebsiteHint: The website comes from available metadata or a matching browser window title. When it cannot be identified, only the browser name is shown.
ConnectPlayersHint: Open Spotify, SoundCloud or another player and play some music. It appears here if it exposes a Windows media session. A browser may share one session across several tabs.
HardwareHint: Keyboard, headset or microphone buttons that control Windows volume.
ShowMediaKeys: Show when changing tracks with media keys
ShowOnStartup: Show the flyout when MediaBack starts
MixerHint: Changing volume in the Windows mixer or Quick Settings does not open MediaBack.
Autostart: Start MediaBack when I sign in to Windows
TrayHint: MediaBack keeps running without the icon. Open settings from Start or run MediaBack.exe again.
PinnedKeys: Media keys control the selected player
KeysSeparateHint: Volume keys and hardware buttons have separate switches above. Use borderless windowed mode for games.
SupportGrows: Your support helps the project grow
SupportParagraph: If the flyout makes your day a little easier, you can leave the author a small thank-you. It helps fix bugs, add useful features and keep the project moving.
SupportCoinsHint: TRX or USDT · address and QR code in the next window
SupportThanks: All MediaBack features are free. Support is optional. Thank you for your feedback, ideas and help ♡
AutosaveHint: Saved automatically · close settings and the flyout keeps running
GreetingLine: Your music. Your style. And a little care from the author.
SupportOptional: MediaBack is free. Support is entirely optional.
CropHint: Drag the image to position it. Use the slider or mouse wheel to zoom.
PositionSubtitle: Choose where and how long the flyout appears.
MusicSubtitle: Keep your music under your control.
SupportSubtitle: A small thank-you makes a big difference.
WaitingPinned: Waiting for the pinned player. Start playing music in it.
FilteredSessions: Sessions were found but filtered out. Select a source manually.
StartPlayer: Open a player and play some music. Its source will appear here.
NoAudio: No audio output device found. Connect headphones or speakers.
SelectBeforeExclude: Select a specific source before excluding it.
SourceExcluded: The source is excluded from automatic selection.
BackgroundSaved: Background saved. Click Show flyout to preview it.
ImageMissing: Background file unavailable · using the theme color
DuplicateShortcut: This shortcut is assigned to another action. Choose a different one or disable that action.
ShortcutHint: Click a shortcut and press your own keys. Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win, function keys and ordinary keys are supported. Shortcuts work in all applications. Single letters can interfere with typing; system shortcuts may be unavailable.
RecordHint: Click and press a shortcut. Esc cancels.
GreetingSubtitle: Enjoying MediaBack? Supporting the author helps make the flyout even better.
CoinSubtitle: Choose a coin. Next, we will show the network, address and QR code.
NetworkSubtitle: Choose the same network you will use in your wallet.
WrongNetwork: The coin and network do not match.
QrNoticePrefix: The QR code contains the address. In your wallet, select
QrUnavailable: QR code unavailable. Copy the address manually.
ClipboardBusy: The clipboard is busy. Select and copy the address manually.
ImageTooLargeBytes: Choose an image smaller than 40 MB.
ImageTooLargePixels: The image is too large. Maximum: 100 megapixels.
QrMissing: No verified QR code is available for this address.
QrInvalid: Could not verify the QR code resource.
PlayerNoCommand: The player does not support this command for the current track.
PlayerCommandFailed: The player did not complete the command. Check the source and playback queue.
MediaStartError: Windows did not provide media sessions:
HookStartError: Could not start the media-key handler.
ShortcutDuplicateAction: “{0}”: this shortcut is already used by another MediaBack action.
ShortcutOccupiedAction: “{0}”: this shortcut is used by another application or reserved by Windows.
GameInteraction: Interact with flyout in a game
CursorHover: Show the cursor over the flyout
GameModeHint: If a game hides the cursor, move it over the flyout. If the pointer is locked to the center, use Interact with flyout in a game: the flyout temporarily takes focus. Esc or the same shortcut returns to the game. Use borderless windowed mode.
